extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the analysis: 1) The 'island' column had a label variant ' Biscoe' (with a leading space) that was merged into 'Biscoe' using normalize_labels. 2) The 'body_mass_g' column was stored as text with commas (e.g., '3,900'), which was converted to numeric values using cast_numeric. 3) One row (row 0) had an impossible body mass of 3,625,000 grams, far exceeding the valid range of 2500–6500 grams; this row was excluded. 4) One exact duplicate row (row 49) was removed to prevent double-counting. After these fixes, the average body mass for females is 3876.0 grams and for males is 4485.2273 grams.
